value.rationale: A first-return tail and independent surface binding with the same critical exponent compete at a physically natural vanishing-reset scale. The theorem describes the whole weak-absorption completion-time distribution, quantifies a reset-dependent crossover, separates two physical delay sources via positive subordinators, and demonstrates that taking weak resetting before the far-time limit changes the survival amplitude. The calibrated protocol threshold distinguishes physically different reinjection mechanisms. These are not consequences of mean waiting times, which are infinite here.
